narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.51 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 48.726-48.970 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 49.409; the first objective pays 1.24R at 48.904.
